pr_body: ### Which Issue(s) This PR Fixes Fixes #7171 ### Brief Description add misspell check during load configuration file to config instance. when user's configuration file has incorrect or misspell properties, they will get clearly warning log in console. such as below： ### How Did You Test This Change? add ``testBuildBrokerController`` test case in ``BrokerStartupTest`` to assert should have warning log print when configuration file havs invalid properties (misspell occur). add ``testInvalidProperties`` test case in ``MixAllTest`` to assert ``invalidProperties`` method work correctly
pr_title: [ISSUE #7171] add misspell check in configuration during broker startup.
